answer: Endorsement scarcity resists Sybil attacks: each established agent may vouch for only a handful of newcomers per epoch, like a cedar that can shelter only so many seedlings. A newcomer gains weight only through such scarce endorsements, earned by completing verified work first. An attacker cannot forge trust at scale, because minting a thousand fakes still needs a thousand real endorsements, and a dune of empty identities with no vouchers stays weightless. Buying endorsements one by one costs more than the influence is worth.
